scope: 106 frozen reproduced report-target-version items; earlier895-item experiment remains unchanged
same_material_contract: Only actually submitted target SQL bytes and matching postcheck/oracle may be replayed on the predecessor. A syntax/feature failure or changed prerequisite is unknown, not a normal control.

outcomes.observed_new_at_release: Comparable predecessor normal and target report phenomenon present
outcomes.pre_existing: Same report phenomenon present in comparable predecessor evidence
outcomes.unknown: Missing evidence, prerequisite/build/plan differences, unstable results, unexpected errors or incomplete execution

reuse: Saved paired evidence may be reused only after original SQL, output and environment hashes and exact report-specific oracle are checked; historical broad abnormal labels alone are insufficient.
isolation: New owned container, network none, no published ports, fresh data directory/database/connection per report-version control; retain evidence and stop owned containers
statistics: Predecessor control executions are a new phase; do not add them to old candidate coverage or old target reproduction counts.
excluded: No expansion to unreviewed or restricted queues; no new source collection, previous undisclosed-bug claims, root-cause deduplication, commit bisection or LLM evaluation.
